NewsArticle.Title: Server Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: Dark Ages servers are online. Dark Ages servers were offline 08:25 - 10:13 PDT for unscheduled server and accounts system synchronization maintenance. We apologize for the inconvenience. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
